description: This file defines an abstract class 'PublicNotices' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboard' and manages lists of 'OnKey' and 'OnVisible' listeners, handling input events and notifying registered listeners accordingly.

classes.name: PublicNotices
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'AnySoftKeyboard' that manages public notices and listener notifications for key and visibility events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the listener lists by retrieving public notices from the application and adding them to respective lists based on their type.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key press events and notifies all registered 'OnKey' listeners.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Called when the input view starts; notifies all 'OnVisible' listeners that the keyboard is visible.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Called when the input view finishes; notifies all 'OnVisible' listeners that the keyboard is hidden.
